331: How soon will I receive a profile? ▾
332: The timeframe depends on the need, the city and available profiles. Write to us on WhatsApp to explain your request, and we will outline the options.
333: What happens if I am not satisfied? ▾
334: If a replacement is needed, the Sérénité and Premium packages provide for this possibility for 2 and 6 months respectively, subject to their terms. Ask for the applicable details before confirming the introduction.
335: How are the placement fees paid? ▾
336: The placement fees are paid only after the profile is approved and the placement is made. You pay nothing before you have found your candidate. The monthly salary is paid directly to the employee, separately from the placement fees.
337: What is the difference between live-in and live-out? ▾
338:
Live-in: the employee stays in the home under the agreed conditions. Working hours and rest days are agreed with the family.

Live-out: hours and arrangements are set according to the role and the agreement with the family.
339: Requirements for hosting a live-in domestic helper
340: Three meals a day of adequate quantity and quality, plus unlimited access to safe drinking water
341: A decent room for her sole use, with privacy
342: Daily rest time must be respected
343: Fair conditions for all three parties: the family, the helper and Yallah Services
344: If these conditions are not met, Yallah Services may withdraw the helper
345: How does a worker organise cooking, cleaning and childcare?
347: Cooking and cleaning are scheduled around naps and times when the child plays independently
348: Duties are agreed in advance with the family
349: Yallah Services explains how this arrangement works to every client who chooses it, to avoid misunderstandings
350: Which cities do you cover? ▾
351: Our main search areas are Casablanca, Bouskoura, Dar Bouazza, Bouznika, Rabat, Marrakech, Tangier, Agadir, Fez, Kenitra, Mohammedia, Temara and Sale. Availability for a specific job and neighbourhood must be confirmed. Day cleaning is offered only in Casablanca and Rabat.
352: Are staff background-checked and trained? ▾
353: We do not claim to conduct background checks or provide certified training. Information shared varies by profile; ask for it and check documents and skills before making a decision.
354: What is the employee's monthly salary? ▾
355: The salary depends on the service and the tasks entrusted. Our official price list (monthly salary paid to the employee):
356: • Cleaning: villa 4,500 MAD · mini villa 4,000 MAD · apartment 3,500 MAD
357: • Nanny: 1 child 3,500 MAD (+ cleaning 4,000 MAD) · 2 children with cleaning 4,500/5,000 MAD · 3 children 4,500 MAD (+ cleaning 5,000 MAD)
358: • Cooking: simple cooking 4,000 MAD · cooking/cleaning 5,000 MAD · kitchen help 3,500 MAD · kitchen help/cleaning 4,000 MAD
360: • Live-out (Casa & Rabat): cleaning 600 MAD/week · cleaning + cooking 800 MAD/week · cleaning + nanny 800 MAD/week
361: • One-off day service (Casa & Rabat): standard cleaning 300/400 MAD · deep cleaning 500/700 MAD
362: These rates are indicative and may vary with the conditions and responsibilities. Placement fees (500 or 1,000 MAD) are added to these salaries. The salary is paid directly to the employee by the household.
363: How does the first meeting with the employee work? ▾
364: You can speak with the person and check relevant information before deciding. If you want another profile, the replacement terms of your chosen package apply.
365: What languages does the employee speak? ▾
366: Languages vary by profile. Tell us which languages you need and ask what information is available about the relevant person before the introduction.
367: What happens if the employee falls ill or leaves? ▾
368: Packages set out replacement terms for a defined period. Ask about the terms for your chosen package before the introduction.
369: Can I hire someone introduced by the agency directly? ▾
370: The terms for direct hiring are not detailed here. Ask Yallah Services for them in writing before making a decision.
371: Where can I review the placement terms? ▾
372: Before approving a profile, ask Yallah Services to provide the fees and terms that apply to your request in writing.
